acceptance_limits: Deterministic source-bound runtime evidence only. Source authentication, claim truth, semantic completeness and consequential authority remain as declared by full output; no whole-system proof/release acceptance follows.

Independent reviewer verifies actual artifact file roster/absence, canonical bytes, module identities and complete expected streams before the fresh receiver run.
Retain first outputs/exits and complete source/carrier inventories before/after; append revisions, never overwrite original failure records.

receiver_preconditions: Use actual qualified existing decoder/source roots; verify SOURCE/INSTALL/RUNTIME and regenerate actual runtime contract as fixed bootstrap does. Receipt from a producer is not qualification input.

Fresh process receives only exported ZIP/share/canonical metadata, not producer Body or original-byte sidecars. Keep named absent paths absent and record pre/post absence.
root_path_caveat: Checker descriptor and installed snapshot bind absolute qualified roots. A moved decoder/checker root requires fresh actual root qualification and mechanical descriptor/Request/Envelope/Invocation rebinding with newly held Request identity; copying an old receipt does not make it qualified. Initial export should demonstrate a fresh same-host process, not claim arbitrary-machine portability.
scope: Smallest source-bound ZIP-only reproducer on the already-qualified fixed Linux/Omarchy host; no cross-host portability or semantic truth claim.
